FOLDED: the sentence re-scoped to the reader's own vendor column ('the cell for your vendor in your row'), so it is live for a Kimi session in arhgap11 and any session in totem-playground; template and both copies; the changeset describes the real fix.

verdict: Leg 1 on the small batch (2be73170..8403f93c, mmnto-ai/totem#2882): 1 BLOCKING, 3 MATERIAL, 5 MINOR. The map widening and all 27 re-derivations survived: every moved expectation restated at equal strength, one genuine strengthening (the per-seat floor gained a rung), one correctly declined re-derivation (the env-override addendum), the equality lock bidirectional (a map seat the table lacks and a table seat the map lacks both red), the docstring's roster claims verbatim-accurate against cohort-roles.md, the content-hash comment claims confirmed against shield.ts and sync.ts, the three signoff renderings byte-identical where they should be with no other managed surface moved by the re-stamp. What it found: F2 the armed CI legs gate is red because the branch touches five legs-owed globs and carried no deposit while the PR body claimed no leg was owed (folded: this deposit committed; the body corrected); F1 the Visiting-case repair swapped one unreachable cell value for another — (not seated) is a Kimi-column cell, never a Claude-column cell (folded: the sentence re-scoped to the reader's own vendor column, in the template and both copies; the changeset says so); F3 'tracked separately' for the codex/agy roster-complete form named no tracker and the only issue that carried it is closed (folded: the follow-on issue filed and cited); F4 the four commits carry the session's attribution trailer while the PR body attributes three to an Opus build leg (folded: the body states both facts — the trailer is the dispatching seat's attribution, the labour ran on an Opus leg — rather than rewriting pushed history); F5 the equality lock's escape hatch is one-directional while its docstring claims symmetry (folded: reworded); F6 the PR body's '27 test expectations' conflated 21 assertions with 6 tests (folded); F7 changeset hygiene — a conventional-commit prefix, internal round vocabulary and the missing fixed-group sentence (folded); F8 the changeset omitted the send-side effect of the map widening (folded: named); F9 the fourth signoff copy (.gemini) was not named in the verification (folded: checked and recorded — Gemini-only table, no Kimi claim, no edit owed).
